## Workflow

Choose one: `new_prd`, `implemented_feature_prd`, `prd_revision`, or
`prd_composition`.

## Raw request

Write the request, source PRD paths and requirement IDs where applicable.

## Expected PRD evidence

Describe the product behavior and any available code, routes, screenshots, or
source PRDs. Figures must be a real capture, isolated reconstruction, or a
controlled placeholder.

## Sensitive data note

Use synthetic or anonymized data only.
